sloka: स तु तेन प्रहारेण महापार्श्वो विचेतनः।ससूतः स्यन्दनात्तस्माद्विसञ्ज्ञः प्रापतद्भुवि ।। ६.९९.७ ।।
transliteration: sa tu tena prahāreṇa mahāpārśvo vicetanaḥ।sasūtaḥ syandanāttasmādvisañjñaḥ prāpatadbhuvi ।। 6.99.7 ।।

translations.english: By that hit, Mahaparsva became unconscious and fell on the ground, senseless, from the chariot along with the charioteer.
